name: Roz Johnson
bio: Roz is the founder of Finance with Flow. A Chartered Accountant (FCA) with over 20 years of experience in setting up and leading Finance teams across small and large corporations, Roz built up a strong team of professionals who have expertise that cover all aspects of finance, providing businesses with a ready-made Outsourced Finance Department. Roz embodies her desire to enable businesses to thrive through Finance with Flow, who would not be able to access this with in-house personnel. Outside of finance, Roz is a Mum of one, spending most weekends as taxi to local mountain bike parks. She is a passionate advocate for holistic well-being and yoga, embracing a mindful and balanced lifestyle.

name: Nasser Rabi Laleh
bio: Nasser is our Management & Systems Accountant at Finance with Flow who has a big passion for numbers. With over ten years of experience working in various finance roles, and being an AAT qualified accountant, Nasser helps businesses streamline financial systems, implement cloud accounting, and gain total transparency over their project margins and performance.

name: Fiona Grange
bio: Fiona is an experienced Management Accountant with deep expertise in financial reporting, variance analysis, and cash flow projections. She partners closely with our clients to transform raw accounting data into actionable insights that inform strategic business decisions.

name: Jackie Jarvis
bio: Jackie ensures our clients daily financial transactions are recorded with meticulous precision. From bank reconciliations and purchase invoices to VAT returns and CIS submissions, Jackie keeps the financial engine running smoothly.

name: Jo
bio: Jo leads our tax compliance and advisory functions, specialising in corporation tax, CIS compliance, and tax efficiency planning for growing businesses and construction contractors.

name: Lorri Morley
bio: Lorri manages marketing, communications, and client onboarding at Finance with Flow. She is passionate about communicating complex financial topics in clear, accessible ways and ensuring seamless client collaboration.
